notes.priority: must-have tasks are never cut; droppable tasks (core:9) may be cut if the build is behind, and nothing depends on them; stretch tasks (ship:16) run only after the LIVE demo hunt (ship:15) is green.
notes.live: live: true marks the three tasks that spend Kane credits (core:2 day-1 spike, core:2.1 spike re-run, ship:15 demo hunt). Their gates are offline; the credit-spending step runs once, in the background (the orchestrator runs that one command itself). Dispatch core:2 first after core:1, and core:2.1 as soon as core:2 is done; dispatch ship:15 only after every must-have task and core:9 (unless cut) is done.
notes.human_gate: No task deploys, moves funds or handles a key or secret: Kane OAuth tokens stay inside kane-cli and the agent uses the local Claude Code login. The public-repo flip, the YouTube upload and the submission are Step-3 campaign gates, outside this manifest.
notes.pending: No replay re-verification stretch task is authored: the day-1 spike (core:2) recorded replayFaithful=false and replayHasValues=false in docs/spike/spike-result.json (spec section 12), so re-verification stays on full Kane runs.
notes.spike_rerun: core:2 chose commas-assert, which lost the stored value on the $20.00 page (run fail-page-commas-assert: status failed, result_code 710, final_state {}). core:2.1 re-runs the spike under the rule that a template must store the value on both pages: it carries the day-1 evidence forward, eliminates commas-assert and sentences-assert without new runs, runs store-only on both pages (2 runs) and writes store-only / value-only to src/kane-profile.ts only if both values were stored. If not, core:2.1 reports BLOCKED with the raw run_end fields and the user decides (spec sections 3 and 12; plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-25-firstbad-core.md Task 2.1).
